sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.65 Dev

  • Folder aggregation: Parent folder-plugin rows now count and filter all descendant child media.
  • Source labeling: Detected folder-plugin rows no longer show the MV pill; only MV-owned collections show MV.
  • Migration modal: Select all and Clear are now proper compact MV buttons.

v1.3.64 Dev

  • Media Studio folder tree: Added a nested MV-styled folder tree in Modules settings with leaf labels, line guides, and counts.
  • Shared tree state: Media Studio and Modules settings now share local expand/collapse state and keep it after reload.

v1.3.63 Dev

  • Migration UI Improvements: Polished Media Studio settings layouts to resolve text alignment and height rhythm.
  • State Syncing: Real-time toggle controls for hiding external sidebar folders.
  • Syntax Fixes: Resolved sidebar list node parsing syntax errors.
